inputs.text: [excited] A hundred two feet long — [amazed] like two and a half school buses, one behind the other. Up at the shoulder, about twenty-one feet tall — [curious] as tall as a street lamp. And fifty-seven thousand kilos — [proud] as heavy as NINETEEN hippos.
[confident] Yep. [whispers] And those skeletons belong to young adults: it could still grow.
